snippet.title: Smalland: Survive the Wilds | PC 1.0 & Console Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Smalland: Survive the Wilds is available now on Steam, Epic, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

After centuries living underground, the Smallfolk emerge from their burrows to reclaim the Overland now that the giants have gone. Join the exodus as a vanguard in an epic adventure played at a tiny scale. Explore, scavenge, craft and build as you fight to gain a foothold in this hostile new world.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/768200/Smalland_Survive_the_Wilds/
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/smalland
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-hr/concept/10008767
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/smalland-survive-the-wilds/9p2zt064fq6f

Follow Smalland: Survive the Wilds on Twitter: https://twitter.com/playsmalland
Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/smalland
